name: UBA
source: African Financials | CRON 2026-10-06: 3 blank cell(s) filled from https://stockanalysis.com/quote/ngx/UBA/financials/income-statement/ . Every value this file already stored agreed with that page within 0.5%, so the fill is additive. Revenue minus Cost of Sales equals Gross Profit and Profit Before Tax minus Income Tax equals Net Profit were re-checked per period; Net Profit was withheld where the source's own figures do not tie. | CRON r16 (2026-10-12): Q1 2026 column from the unaudited group results of United Bank for Africa Plc for the three months ended 31 March 2026, filed with the NGX, NGN million scaled to absolute NGN: Gross earnings 801,462; Interest income 641,095; Interest expense 257,384; Net interest income 383,711; Total non-interest income 137,138; Operating income 520,849; Impairment charge 41,242; Total operating expenses 318,952; Profit before income tax 160,655; Taxation charge 14,032; Profit for the period 146,623; basic earnings per share 3.11. Ties: operating income 520,849 less the 41,242 impairment charge less total operating expenses 318,952 equals the printed profit before income tax 160,655; 160,655 less 14,032 equals 146,623. Revenue holds the printed Operating income line, the measure this file uses for its own FY2021 and FY2022 columns (430,131 and 550,656, the UBA printed operating income for those years). The column previously held 3,190,000,000,000 (3.19 trillion) for one quarter, which is larger than the FY2025 revenue in the same file and cannot be a quarter of a year. Interest expense is stored in Net Finance Costs positive, matching the FY2025 column. A bank income statement carries no cost of sales, gross profit or operating profit (EBIT) line.
